prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE newly composed original narrative illustration, not a collage, not a sheet, no inset portrait or lettering.
Drawing direction: Soft Thunder.
Input images: Image 1: Actual earlier new encounter frame ST03; preserve identity, equipment, creature construction, geography and persistent state. New action and camera.
Image 2: Tavi and armored opponent identity, elastic gesture and quiet cartoon surfaces.
Image 3: Original drawing treatment reference only. New identity and action; preserve this style rather than importing Nightglass rendering.
Current subject, place and power constraints: Tavi is the same light-skinned muscular adult woman about29 with short blond quiff, expressive eyebrows, turquoise sleeveless battle top, olive cropped trousers, orange sash, cream/orange boots and one turquoise-shaft combat hammer with a large cream head and orange striking face. Opponent Bellguard is a much larger adult in charcoal-purple full armor, closed hornless helmet with warm eye slit, red waistcloth and heavy gauntlets, empty hands. Simple dry pale arena surrounded by distant windmills, low wall behind, no rubble carpet. Preserve elastic outlined cartoon drawing and broad clean color shapes rather than generic glossy fantasy. Her first hammer hit leaves ONE broad orange ring on his raised forearm guard; the ring indicates one delayed secondary impulse. He counterpunches before it releases; she must evade. Keep adults, strong hands and distinct bent limbs. Fixed anatomical sides: Bellguard LEFT forearm carries the orange ring; his RIGHT fist counterpunches. Tavi sweeps behind Bellguard RIGHT knee with direct visible shaft contact. Keep these sides across camera changes.
Requested image: ST04 A laugh between breaths; consequence. Camera: portrait quiet medium.
Bellguard sits heavily on the pale arena floor, one knee bent, other leg extended, armor intact but dusty, orange pulse completely gone. Tavi kneels a pace away leaning on her hammer's intact shaft, chipped orange face resting on the ground. She is breathless and laughing; he tilts his helmet at her with reluctant respect. Adult proportions and readable hands. No sparks, no floating rubble, broad warm sky and a distant windmill.
Art direction: beautiful memorable adult faces, decisive gesture and readable body mechanics. Preserve the original reference drawing treatment and recent quiet surfaces. Clear force, contact, body response and purposeful negative space. Dry ground in broad matte light/shadow planes; no reflective floor, tiny tile tessellation, all-over scratches, grain, crack webs, microfacets or sparkle. Selective detail belongs at faces, grips, joints and decisive contact. Keep material differences and intentional broad brushwork. Restrained effects with a clear direction; no generic aura, particle storm or rubble carpet. Continuous intact weapon construction with understandable grips. Draw only physically plausible limbs, deliberate occlusion, no floating props. No text, labels, watermark, speech balloons, split panels or franchise copies. Aspect ratio: portrait 2:3.
